Signed actions (testnet)

Verified wallets: Meteor Wallet (extension, primary) and MyNearWallet testnet redirect (https://testnet.mynearwallet.com — sunset started Oct 31 2026). HERE Wallet is also listed for mobile. Gasless withdraw stays CLI-only (relayer secrets never ship to the browser).

Mint demo mUSDC

Anyone can mint mock USDC to themselves (faucet token).

Pay household

ft_transfer_call → live pocket split.

Withdraw from my pocket

Must be pocket owner; recipient must be allowlisted. Contract panics surface below.

Propose rule change

Owner only. Demo: keep current shares (noop proposal) or paste JSON PocketInput[].

Create household (factory)

Deploys <name>.b575-factory.testnet with you as owner. Attach ~3 NEAR.

Demo storyline

  1. Pay 200 mUSDC into the household → it splits 40/25/15/10/10 (spend / rent / mom / taxes / savings).
  2. Mom withdraws 10 mUSDC to her destination account (gasless via the relayer).
  3. The agent tries to drain savings and is blocked (not the pocket owner; FC key limited).
  4. Even the household owner cannot pull more than the savings daily cap.

Run bash scripts/e2e.sh to reproduce on testnet. Links below are from the last recorded run.

    Try it

    1. Dev: cd web && npm install && npm run dev → http://127.0.0.1:8080
    2. Static (GitHub Pages): serve web/dist/ (python3 -m http.server 8080 inside dist).
    3. Toggle EN/ES with the header button (saved in localStorage). Connect Meteor or MyNearWallet testnet.
